name: 06604 · Bridgeport, CT
findings: ZIP 06604 (Bridgeport) has 271 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 73 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06604 (Bridgeport) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06604 (Bridgeport) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 73 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
